title: nassella planaltina
intro: Nassella planaltina, commonly known as "Pampas Grass", is a perennial grass species native to South America. It is used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include aiding in digestion and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Nassella planaltina are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
